g.title: peripherals
g.text: Each device owns a window; the CPU sees one read-data mux and one wired-AND interrupt line.

g.title: cpu
g.text: for the register inside a window

g.title: chain
g.text: write data, control strobes, CPU state

g.title: term
g.text: (a control write with bits 1:0 = 11 holds the
status at 0 and empties the keyboard buffer -
what RomWBW's ACIA driver probes for)
CGA font ROM, 2-bit RGB colour video output
kbEnable drops keys while the SSP terminal

g.title: uart
g.text: rx/tx clocked by the serial baud DDS
shared with the SSP over the console mux

g.title: sd
g.text: raw SPI to the physical SD socket
(SDSC byte address or SDHC block address),
sdClock from a clk_sys divider, driveLED out

g.title: bd
g.text: identical register layout to sd_controller, so
one driver serves both - but there is no SPI:
asks the HPS to move one 512-byte block
between a mounted image and a sector buffer
reports image size and read-only state

g.title: rtc
g.text: RTC register file modelled; date and time
are supplied by the MiSTer HPS (hps_rtc,

g.title: bt
g.text: OUT to a channel latches it,
ch 0/1 tick at 1 ms, ch 2/3 at 1 us

g.title: fp
g.text: refresh tick drives the single-wire PHY
profile from the OSD file (.FPP) or the
OSD profile override, without the Z-80
